# Test Plan — COPY TEMPLATE

**Use:** Evidence for a coherent feature or subsystem. Copy this file into its owning level or dedicated subdirectory; replace all placeholders; register a unique ID. Never leave the copy template itself as an accepted specification.

## Common metadata (required)

- **ID:** `{{ID}}` — stable across renames/moves; never recycle.
- **Title:** `{{TITLE}}`
- **Purpose:** `{{QUESTION_THIS_ANSWERS}}`
- **Level:** `{{LEVEL}}`
- **Status:** `proposed | accepted | implemented | verified | deprecated | superseded` (use one; implementation and verification details can additionally be tracked in the requirements register).
- **Maintainer:** `{{ROLE_OR_HANDLE}}`
- **Applies to:** `{{MILESTONE_OR_VERSION}}`
- **Upstream authority:** `{{LINKS_TO_HIGHER_LEVEL_SPECS}}`
- **Downstream dependencies:** `{{LINKS_TO_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_TESTS}}`
- **Verification:** `{{MEANS_OF_CHECKING_THIS_DOCUMENT}}`
- **Decision/history:** `{{GIT_OR_ADR_REFERENCES}}`
- **Last reviewed:** `{{YYYY-MM-DD}}`
